g.text: Other investment (bank loans, deposits, trade credit)
Source: IMF Balance of Payments Statistics (country data, dataflow BOP 21.0.0) and World Economic Outlook (nominal GDP in US dollars, dataflow WEO 9.0.0), IMF SDMX
3.0 API, downloaded 2026-11-05. Inflows = net incurrence of liabilities to non-residents (BPM6), summed over all reporting economies (economies reporting FDI
inflows: 145 in 1996, 182 in 2007, 159 in 2025; fewer report derivatives), in % of world GDP. Negative values are net repayments or withdrawals. Reserve
accumulation = net acquisition of reserve assets by central banks (asset side), shown as a line, not stacked. Portfolio flows reported without an equity/debt split
(0.1% of gross flows) are not stacked. 2025 is preliminary (159 reporters).
